featured_reviews.name: vikram kantore
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently travelled to Japan with The Passport Paradise, and it was genuinely one of the most well-curated and seamless trips I’ve experienced. A big thank you to Neha Kapoor and Kunjal, their attention to detail and thoughtful planning really showed throughout the journey.

One thing I was initially unsure about was travelling with a group of 12 complete strangers, I did have some hesitation going in. But that feeling didn’t last long at all. The trip was organised in such a comfortable and easygoing way that I found myself at ease very quickly, and it ended up being a really enjoyable part of the experience.

We covered Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka, and the hotels in every city were perfectly located in central, upscale neighbourhoods, which made exploring both easy and comfortable.

What stood out for me personally was the care taken with food. As a vegetarian, I usually expect limited options while travelling, but that wasn’t the case here at all. The team had clearly put thought into selecting restaurants, and I got to enjoy some excellent vegan and vegetarian meals throughout the trip.

The itinerary struck a great balance, we experienced everything from the bullet train and Nara Deer Park to Shibuya Sky and the immersive TeamLab digital art museum. Experiencing Japan during the cherry blossom season was truly special, and the way it was seamlessly woven into the itinerary made it even more memorable, without ever feeling rushed. It felt like we got to truly experience Japan, not just move through it.

In sum, The Passport Paradise elevates travel beyond the transactional into the realm of the experiential. It is a connoisseur’s approach to exploration, one that lingers in the memory long after the journey has concluded. I would recommend them, without the slightest reservation, to any discerning traveller.

featured_reviews.name: Jeeri Deka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wow! I just got back from the trip of a lifetime through South Africa with Passport Paradise, and I'm still buzzing from the experience! From the moment we landed in Joburg (as the locals call it), I knew we were in for something special. Our amazing trip leader Neha, who's actually the founder of Passport Paradise, made us feel like family right from our first group Christmas dinner at the 11th floor.

Let me tell you - this wasn't your typical touristy schedule. Sure, we hit the must-sees like Table Mountain, the V&A Waterfront, Cape of Good Hope in Cape Town, but Neha took us to hidden gems that most visitors miss. We found ourselves sipping sundowners at sunset cruise, watching the sun paint the sky in incredible colors. And the food? Don't even get me started on the mouth-watering food!

The absolute highlight had to be our time in Kruger. We stayed at the luxurious Radisson, where we could see Impalas from the room balcony! Our private game drives were incredible - we spotted an incredible amount of wildlife within just two days, and our ranger shared fascinating stories about local wildlife conservation efforts. One evening, we even had a sunset drinks with the Giraffes and Zebras.

Back in Cape Town, we explored the Cape Winelands, enjoying private tastings at iconic estate - Stellenbosch. The sunset cruise around the Cape Peninsula was unforgettable - we even spotted some playful seals and penguins! Between activities, we stayed at absolutely gorgeous hotels, which honestly felt more like living in luxury homes than hotels.

What made everything extra special was Neha's personal touch and attention to details. She isn't just knowledgeable about travelling - she's passionate about it. She knew exactly what she was doing and crafted an memorial experience.

If you're dreaming of exploring South Africa, you absolutely need to check out Passport Paradise. They've nailed the perfect mix of luxury and authentic local experiences. I'm already planning my next trip with them ! 🦁✨

featured_reviews.name: Akkashh Surryavanshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently traveled to Iceland with them and I couldn’t be more impressed with the entire experience. From start to finish, the trip was impeccably organized and filled with unforgettable moments that truly showcased the beauty and uniqueness of Iceland.

Booking and Preparation:
The booking process was seamless, with the team providing clear details about the itinerary, packing tips, and travel advice. They were responsive to all my questions and even offered personalized recommendations based on my interests.

Itinerary and Activities:
The itinerary was thoughtfully designed, balancing adventure, relaxation, and cultural immersion. Highlights included visiting the Golden Circle, exploring glaciers and ice caves, soaking in the Blue Lagoon, and witnessing the magical Northern Lights. Every activity felt well-planned, and there was enough time to soak in the breathtaking landscapes without feeling rushed.

Guides and Accommodations:
Our guide Olga was knowledgeable, friendly, and clearly passionate about Iceland’s history and nature. They shared fascinating stories and facts that enriched the experience. The accommodations were comfortable, clean, and conveniently located, with a great mix of cozy guesthouses and modern hotels.

Customer Service:
The customer service exceeded expectations. Whether it was handling last-minute changes due to weather (a reality in Iceland!) or providing restaurant recommendations, the team went above and beyond to ensure we had the best trip possible.

Overall Experience:
Iceland itself is a dream destination, and Neha and team made it even more memorable with their professionalism, expertise, and attention to detail. I highly recommend them to anyone planning a trip to this stunning country.

featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable 24-Day Safari & Culture Journey Through India – With Raj and Wanderlust Travel Hub

From the moment we first connected with Raj from Wanderlust Travel Hub, we knew we were in the best hands. A dear mutual friend referred us to him, and after more than a year of thoughtful planning and communication, our dream of exploring India came to life in the most personal, heartfelt, and beautifully organized way imaginable.

This was our very first visit to India — a place we had always dreamed of — and what Raj created for us will stay in our hearts forever. From the start on November 7th in Delhi, we began our journey to Jim Corbett National Park, where luck was on our side — a magnificent tiger appeared beside the road just minutes before reaching our lodge! Over the next 24 days, we traveled through some of India’s most iconic national parks and cultural treasures, each day full of wonder:

- Jim Corbett and the rare Great Hornbill sightings
- The Taj Mahal and city of Agra with our a knowledgeable local guide
- Keoladeo National Park with its spectacular birdlife
- Ranthambore with its stunning fort and amazing wildlife
- Chambal Gharial Sanctuary — spotting the critically endangered gharial crocodiles
- Jaipur’s charm, history, shopping and great local streetfood
- Visits to Tadoba, Pench, Kanha, and Bandhavgarh — we had 20 safaris in total on our tour, spotting tigers, wild dogs, sloth bears, countless birds, and the endless beauty of India’s wilderness
- Our final days brought us to Khajuraho’s mesmerizing temples and the tastiest aloo chaat street food we’ve ever had! A spontaneous stop Gwalior to see the awe-inspiring Gopachal Jain Statues and Gwalior Fort was the perfect way to close this magical journey before returning to Delhi.

None of this would have been the same without Raj. Beyond being a phenomenal tour organizer, he became a true friend — someone whose warmth, humor, and genuine care turned every day into a joy. His daily surprises with local food, his stories, and his kind guidance made us experience India not as visitors but as family.

A special mention also goes to our wonderful driver, Shubhram, whose calmness, skill, and friendly presence made long journeys smooth and safe.

If you are planning to visit India — especially for your first time — we cannot recommend Wanderlust Travel Hub highly enough. Raj creates journeys that are not just well-organized and safe, but deeply personal. Every lodge, guide, and experience feels handpicked with love and authenticity.

We will carry India — and Raj — in our hearts forever.
